why: Boltz ran with an empty `ligand_smiles`, so `BoltzPredictAgent.run` appended no ligand chain to the YAML. Boltz then folded a bare protein perfectly well, and its confidence JSON has no `ligand_iptm` key at all. The extraction used to fall back to `iptm` and then to 0.0, which turned 'the ligand was never modelled' into 'the ligand binds badly': a broken run that only an acceptance threshold noticed. `_boltz_metrics` now reports only what Boltz wrote, so the value is absent, and the INTEGRITY gate `metrics_reported` catches it - which is what keeps this from counting toward trust (docs/decisions/0013). The protein is excellent and the campaign's objective - does it bind the ligand - was measured on nothing. This is backlog A2 as a QC payload. `output_present` and the `complex_plddt` threshold both PASS: it takes the presence check to see it.
